findings.source: BowlofTreats.gd/tscn and CSV; no Godot parsing/execution.

findings.facts: Bowl.onPrepare resets REAL ledger0 and scans all same-inventory Pets independently of stars. Food.canAffect is spatial Food with different descriptor. Item.prepare freezes its cache and invokes onPrepare before Food.prepare adds own count*0.1 speed. Baseline551 generic Food speed is already after per-item onPrepare dispatch. Squirrel retains Pet OR Food and Wolper Pet-only caches.
findings.obligation: Apply20/100 once, preserve receiver chance when receiver prepares later, do not treat cache_prepared as completed setter loop. Setter has no callback/RNG; expected0/.2 observational checks must not run midway against unfinished contributions. Missing/duplicate/unowned/nonfinite or wrong chance rejects instead of repairing.

findings.topic: One trigger, complete effects, live positive flip
findings.facts: Original Item.trigger4409–4416 adjusts cooldown and increments triggerTime once, invokes full first effect, then reads live positive chance and draws one Util.flip(raw<=chance), optionally invoking effect once again. No recursion, second adjust or newly introduced ended/activation-result condition. Chance0 consumes no extra-effect draw, unlike attackEffectCount default-zero behavior.
findings.obligation: Extract only existing Squirrel steal→activate and Wolper least→activate branches into tiny production helper. First Squirrel pitch remains before extra roll, second picker/pitch after it. Preserve all nonPet branches and unchanged kernels.

findings.facts: Original activate fourth+ attempt returns normally before event/metric/pitch; this does not cancel effect or Item.trigger remaining positive roll. First attempt already fourth can still roll and execute second effect with fifth suppressed activation. First-third event/pitch may occur then fourth suppression. Already-ended in-limit activation reaches Squirrel pitch while event/metrics are suppressed; no new trigger-ended check.
findings.obligation: Directed controls must use actual production effects/activate and label synthetic same-time/ended prestates; no event or missing pitch is not proof no effect/draw occurred.

findings.facts: Bowl first giveRandomBuffs2, then if ledger<100 gives min(25,100-ledger)/100 to each affected Food using same pre-loop ledger; only after target loop adds25 once, even for empty list. At cap, buffs and activate still execute. Synthetic90 gives10% each and stores115, not100.
findings.obligation: Real mutable ItemState.bowl_speed_bonus_given REAL0 reset/onPrepare, serialized by existing asdict; no reconstruction from history. Existing double_activation_chance stays real serialized field. Do not add an invented ledger tooltip/event.

findings.topic: Cache hooks, histories and current event
findings.facts: Existing Item.addToInventory item_added/item_removed/item_type_changed hooks and ordered affected caches suffice under fixed inventory. Food adds no combat buff listener. Wolper listener remains its own prepare position. Random2 existing delayed flush precedes Food speed loop. add_speed snapshots Speed3 then Cooldown9 at current global event_num, including calls at zero, with existing history dedup.
findings.obligation: Do not bind snapshots to cached buff id, future Bowl Activation or next_event; do not add listener/modifier framework.
